name: YMCA Camp of Maine
description_short: Overnight YMCA camp founded in 1915 on the shores of Lake Cobbossee in Winthrop, Maine, offering one- and two-week sessions for boys and girls. Programs listed include Traditional Camp, Explorer's Camp and a LIT/CIT program.
